shorts.title: GTA 6: 61 Cheats, but There's a Catch
shorts.description:
GTA 6's cheats only unlock after you beat the story, each has its own challenge, and using one turns off trophies and saving.
Will you use cheats? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: Don't Fish for Money
shorts.description:
Fishing in GTA 6 is catch and release, so there are no fish to sell. Fish to chill and make money elsewhere.
Fishing fan or nah? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: Chapter 3's Better Car Buyer
shorts.description:
Pay 'n' Spray buys stolen cars from Chapter 3 of GTA 6, about $2,500 to $4,000 each, guides say. Standard trackers OK, advanced go to Randy, and there's a daily limit.
Still selling to Moses? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts
